metadata.title: कैसे बनती है हंडिया ।How to make Rice Beer । The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we take you to a village in Odisha. We are going to beer bar, to learn how the tribal women prepare rice beer, and Mahua wine. 
These bars are special in more ways than one. One it's run by women and, it is a safe space for women to come in and have a drink. The best part is they are not expensive at all!!
